content.title: IconSwapper: A New Way to Customize Mac Icons with Live Data
content.caption: Michael Flarup's IconSwapper app lets users replace app icons with live data, adding a whimsy to Mac desktop setups.

slides.heading: IconSwapper: A New Way to Customize Mac Icons with Live
slides.text: Michael Flarup's IconSwapper app lets users replace app icons with live data, adding a whimsy to Mac desktop setups.

slides.heading: What is IconSwapper?
slides.text: IconSwapper is a Mac utility that allows users to replace app icons with live data, adding a whimsy to Mac desktop setups.

slides.heading: How does IconSwapper work?
slides.text: IconSwapper works by drawing directly on the icons without replacing them, allowing users to use shaders, motion, and display real data.
